title: Lactylation modulation identifies key biomarkers and therapeutic targets in KMT2A-rearranged AML.
authors: Liu, Dan; Liu, Silu; Ji, Yujie; Jin, Ziyan; He, Zhewei; Hou, Mengjia; Li, Dongyang; Ma, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦KMT2A重排AML中乳酸化修饰相关基因与预后标志物，属纯转录组/表型分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) with KMT2A rearrangements (KMT2Ar), found on chromosome 11q23, is often called KMT2A-rearranged AML (KMT2Ar-AML). This variant is highly aggressive, characterized by rapid disease progression and poor outcomes. Growing knowledge of epigenetic changes, especially lactylation, has opened new avenues for investigation and management of this subtype. Lactylation plays a significant role in cancer, inflammation, and tissue regeneration, but the underlying mechanisms are not yet fully understood. This research examined the influence of lactylation on gene expression within KMT2Ar-AML, initially identifying twelve notable lactylation-dependent differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Using advanced machine learning techniques, six key lactylation-associated genes (PFN1, S100A6, CBR1, LDHB, LGALS1, PRDX1) were identified as essential for prognostic evaluation and linked to relevant disease pathways. The study also suggested PI3K inhibitors and Pevonedistat as possible therapeutic options to modulate immune cell infiltration. Our findings confirm the critical role of lactylation in KMT2Ar-AML and identify six key genes that may serve as biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment. In addition to highlighting the need for further validation in clinical settings, these findings contribute to our understanding of KMT2Ar-AML's molecular mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 急性髓系白血病（Acute Myeloid Leukemia, AML）中伴有KMT2A重排（KMT2A rearrangements, KMT2Ar）的亚型，定位于染色体11q23，常被称为KMT2A重排型AML（KMT2Ar-AML）。该变异型具有高度侵袭性，以疾病快速进展和预后不良为特征。对表观遗传变化，尤其是乳酸化（lactylation）的日益深入了解，为这一亚型的研究和管理开辟了新途径。乳酸化在癌症、炎症和组织再生中发挥重要作用，但其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。本研究探讨了乳酸化对KMT2Ar-AML中基因表达的影响，初步识别出十二个显著的乳酸化依赖性差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。利用先进的机器学习技术，六个关键的乳酸化相关基因（PFN1、S100A6、CBR1、LDHB、LGALS1、PRDX1）被确定为预后评估的关键因子，并与相关疾病通路相关联。研究还提出PI3K抑制剂和Pevonedistat作为调节免疫细胞浸润的潜在治疗选择。我们的发现证实了乳酸化在KMT2Ar-AML中的关键作用，并识别出六个可能作为诊断和治疗生物标志物的关键基因。除了强调在临床环境中进一步验证的必要性外，这些发现还增进了我们对KMT2Ar-AML分子机制的理解。
